name: Sensor Ghost
label: Dischord
lede: Three D.C. lifers from Puff Pieces, Antelope and Weed Tree started a no-wave trio, then drove to Inner Ear twice with Ian MacKaye and Don Zientara. The second trip became Dischord No. 198, pressed on translucent yellow vinyl.

eras.title: Three lifers and a skewed trio
eras.text: Sensor Ghost grew out of a D.C. underground that never stopped after the hardcore years. Its members had played in Puff Pieces, Antelope, Weed Tree, Light Beams, Vertebrates, Stigmatics and The Cornel West Theory. Dischord files them with the city's freaked-out, iconoclastic side, the no-wave end of D.C. punk instead of the fast end.

years.cap: Sensor Ghost at DC9, Washington, April 30, 2022
q: Known to leave listeners in a discombobulated trance.
years.src: Dischord: Sensor Ghost · Dischord: S/t cassette
years.h: Sensor Ghost starts up as a three-piece
years.p: Dischord dates the band to 2019: Mike Andre on bass and vocals, Amanda Huron on guitar, Sam Lavine on drums. The label calls them a no-wave art-punk trio.
years.xp:
Before any Dischord record, the band put out a self-titled cassette on its own, catalog number SG01. Devin Ocampo recorded it at Ivakota studio in D.C.; his own record-making runs through [[Faraquet|e866e006-4c80-4753-b53f-1bc5d88ccddd]], [[Medications|c545a7bf-c8d7-4368-8009-22e19d8911ce]] and The Effects.

Start dates differ by source. Huron's own site titles the band's page "Sensor Ghost (2021-present)"; Dischord says 2019.

eras.title: Into Inner Ear, twice
eras.text: In 2024 the band did what D.C. punk bands have done since 1980 and went to Don Zientara's Inner Ear studio with Ian MacKaye in the room. A three-song single came first, co-released with Lovitt Records. The debut LP session followed in March.

years.cap: Sensor Ghost at Rhizome DC, September 16, 2023

years.h: Three songs at Inner Ear, co-released with Lovitt
years.p: Sensor Ghost cut Psychic Robots, Crystal Spa and Still Sour with Don Zientara and Ian MacKaye. Dischord and Lovitt Records put the 3 Song 7" out together as Dischord No. 196.5.
years.xp: It's the band's first record on Dischord and the follow-up to the self-released cassette. Dischord added the single to its store on January 24, 2024; the digital version is $3.

eras.title: A year later, the LP
eras.text: Irritation on Demand came out a year after the Inner Ear session as Dischord No. 198, a label catalog that began with the Teen Idles in 1980.

years.cap: Sensor Ghost at Haydees Restaurant, Mount Pleasant, March 15, 2025
years.src: Dischord: Irritation on Demand · Dischord news: Irritation · Bandcamp
years.h: Eleven songs on yellow vinyl: Irritation on Demand
years.p: Sensor Ghost's debut LP was cut at Inner Ear in March 2024 with Ian MacKaye and Don Zientara, then pressed on translucent yellow vinyl. It's Dischord No. 198.
years.xp:
The eleven songs run from Plant Life to Probable Impact, with Merely Pumice, Wimpy Heart and Lamentations of the Scene in between. In February 2025 Dischord posted the title track on Bandcamp and opened pre-orders at $20, shipping them with any other items on release day.

Dischord pitched the record as the work of a band indebted to the freaked-out sonics and iconoclastic creativity of the storied D.C. punk scene.
